classification.rule: Explicit finish_reason=length takes precedence over JSON parser exception; completion reached effective budget and response ended before valid JSON completion.

proven: Graphiti 0.29.3 extract_edges sends max_tokens=16384, while the failed MemBind path recorded an effective 8192 budget.
Pinned Graphiti Edge and ExtractedEdges schemas contain unbounded string fields, an unbounded episode_indices array, and no additionalProperties=false closure.
The Qwen transport records finish_reason, usage, effective max_tokens, and raw response metadata before generic JSON parsing.
The generic Graphiti parser currently calls json.loads before consulting finish_reason, so length-capped JSON is misreported as JSONDecodeError.
Graphiti's upstream retry wrapper is replaced by a local single-attempt seam for the 8B runtime.
No old campaign runner process was active at audit time; the replacement attempt has no terminal artifact and remains incomplete.
inferred: The unbounded edge field space materially increased the probability that grammar-conforming generation would consume the output budget before closing JSON.
The smaller effective budget than upstream Graphiti increased truncation exposure in the failed path.
unknown: Whether any Neo4j write occurred before the failed source in the old runner cannot be established from the available failure artifact alone.
Whether the truncated response content itself was semantically recoverable is intentionally not inferred and will not be reconstructed.

next_falsifiable_hypothesis.statement: A recursively closed schema with finite field, array, and numeric bounds plus a conservative tokenizer certificate can reject or split every oversized request before provider invocation and prevent a valid bound-certified request from silently reaching an unbounded grammar.
